By way of the present application filed under section 483 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita 2023, the petitioner seeks interim bail in case FIR No.701/2023 dated 26.07.2023 registered under section 376 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 and section 6 of the Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012 at P.S.:
Shahbad Dairy.

sentences.text: 5. The status report is taken on record.

6. Dr. M. P. Singh, learned counsel appearing for the petitioner submits, that the petitioner has been in custody for more than 2 years; and that there is no adverse report against him from jail; nor does he have any other criminal involvements.
7. Dr. Singh submits, that the wedding functions would commence on 15.02.2026 and would conclude on 20.02.2026.
8. Pursuant to intimation sent, the prosecutrix is also present in court.
She expresses apprehension of threat and intimidation at the hands of the petitioner.

9. However, from the record it is seen that though ordinarily the petitioner was a resident of Kailash Nagar, Delhi, however for purposes of his son's wedding, he would be travelling to the bride's native place in Uttar Pradesh.
On the other hand, the prosecutrix is stated to be a resident of Shahbad Dairy, Delhi.

10. Upon a conspectus of the foregoing facts and circumstances, this court is inclined to grant to the petitioner - Rajesh Soni s/o Budh Sagar - interim bail for the period beginning 14.02.2026 upto 24.02.2026 on the following conditions:
10.1.

The petitioner shall furnish a personal bond in the sum of Rs.15,000/- (Rs.
Fifteen Thousand Only) with 01 local surety in
This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.

The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 04/02/2026 at 20:33:41 the like amount from a family member, to the satisfaction of the Jail Superintendent;
10.2.

The petitioner shall not leave District: Baharaich, Uttar Pradesh where the functions are to be held, except for purposes of travelling to and from prison; and except for visiting his own place of residence in Delhi;
10.3.
In particular, the petitioner shall not visit the colony where the prosecutrix resides in Delhi;

10.4. The petitioner shall present himself before the Investigating Officer/S.H.O of the local police station in District: Baharaich, Uttar Pradesh on every Monday between 11 am and 11:30 am to mark his presence.

However, he will not be kept waiting longer than an hour for this purpose;
10.5.

The petitioner shall furnish to the Investigating Officer/S.H.O P.S.: Shahbad Dairy a cell-phone number on which the petitioner may be contacted at any time and shall ensure that the number is kept active and switched-on at all times; 10.6.
If the petitioner has a passport, he shall surrender the same to the Jail Superintendent and shall not travel out of the country without the prior permission of this court;
